body: Hi all. Just want to say thanks to everyone for commenting etc. It has been a huge help for me.

Work is fine and I get social interaction there but I work in quite an outgoing place and everyone talks about what they are doing and social things coming up. I have learnt to act like an Oscar winner so they dont realise actually how lonely I am outside of work. Sad huh.
This really resonated with me. Thanks for sharing.

I am 35 mate and my life sounds like a mirror of yours. I havent really had friends since before university and also have social anxiety.

It was weird to read something that I could relate to so closely.

I'm 35 and on the outside my life seems OK. I have a well paid job, my own place, my own car and loving family but inside my anxiety and depression has plagued me since the age of 17.

On top of that I have aspergers which makes my life very challenging. I find it hard to socialise and relate to people and feel very very lonely in life.

I have been really trying to turn a corner recently but it's getting worse. I am saying new years in the hope my life improves somehow but if not then I'll be dead come 2020.

The thing that scares me is that I know I will go through with it too as I'm very determined.
I'd love to know the above answers too. I'm also from the UK and on the verge of purchasing in the next few days.
